content: Mǝgam ak malǝmcemana à kǝ̀ karì ka nǝ̀ panzǝi
A ɓabù mǝlì mala Yì ɓwa mǝnana do amur buno-murǝm ngga, ǝn sǝn ɓè malǝmce mana à kǝ̀ karì ka,
Sǝ ǝn sǝn ɓè nggea kanggǝrang mǝturonjar mala Ɓakuli came loasǝ gì bàng-bàng, aban hama ama, <<Yana ɓwe kārǝa nǝ fasǝki amyang mǝnia à lanzǝkina kún mǝnia yì malǝmce nǝi ka, sǝ nǝ̀ panzǝi?>>
Sǝ ko kǝɓwa pà kàm a kùli, ko a nzali, ko a tà-nzali, mǝnana kārǝa nǝ̀ mǝn mǝnia yì malǝmce, ko nǝ̀ sǝn gìr mǝnana à gilǝì aɓalǝi ka ɗàng.
Pǝlǝa ǝn kpa ɓua kǝ̀rkǝ́r, acemǝnana à kum kǝɓwa mǝnana kārǝa nǝ̀ mǝn mǝnia yì malǝmce, ko nǝ̀ sǝn ɓālǝi ka ɗàng.

Pǝlǝa mwashat atà aɓwana-mǝgule mǝno lumi-ɓari-nong-ine ka nam ama, <<Pwalo, ce a ɓua ɗàng! Sǝni, ɓwa mǝnana à tunǝki ama Im, a tàu mala Yahuda, sǝ ɗǝm ngga Mǝkà murǝm Dauda na ka, linamurǝm mǝnana tsǝì kārǝ́na nǝ̀ fasǝki amyang-kun yì malǝmce, mǝnana à lanzǝi nǝia ka, sǝ nǝ̀ mǝnni.>>

Pǝlǝa ǝn sǝn Mǝgam mǝnana pa kǝla à pwan-myali ka, nda aban came nǝ ɓaɓalǝu a ban buno-murǝm, sǝ agiryilǝmu mǝno ine andǝ aɓwana-mǝgule ka, à kàrì aɓalǝu. Ndanǝ anjawe tongno-nong-ɓari andǝ amǝsǝu tongno-nong-ɓari, amǝnana à nda ka bangŋo tongno-nong-ɓari mala Ɓakuli mǝnana à tasǝia arǝ aban kat aɓa ɓanza ka.
Mǝgam nì pǝlǝa yiu yi ak malǝmce nî a bù-mǝlì mala Yì ɓwa mǝnana do amur buno-murǝm ngga.

Lang angŋǝna malǝmcenî ka, agiryilǝmu mǝno ine andǝ aɓwana-mǝgule lumi-ɓari-nong-ine ka, à sarǝa a nzali a ɓadǝm Mǝgam. Koyana ateà ka ndanǝ zangŋan, sǝ à bwal amuna-nkenye bolo-njengǝlan a buia mǝnana à lùmsǝia nǝ muku-gìr ace loasǝ yele mǝ'rǝmɓoarne ka; yì muku-gìr ace loasǝ yele mǝ'rǝmɓoarne ka nda ka ahiwi mala aɓwana mala Ɓakuli.
Pǝlǝa agiryilǝmu andǝ aɓwana-mǝgule mǝno tù bǝsa nggyal ama:

content.text: sǝ nǝ nkilio sǝ a akmúr

content: Lang mǝ ndaban sǝnban ngga, ǝn ok gì amǝturonjar mala Ɓakuli pas. Làkkì malea na á-pas andǝ amilǝyan amur amilǝyan! À gumbǝli buno-murǝm andǝ agiryilǝmu andǝ aɓwana-mǝgule aɓalǝu.
À loasǝ già a kùli à tu-nggyal ama:

Pǝlǝa ǝn ok agir mǝnana kat Ɓakuli pusǝia ka, amǝnana a kùli, andǝa mǝnana a nzali, andǝa mǝnana a tǝta nzali, andǝa mǝnana a tamur ka, andǝ koya gìr mǝnana kat aɓalǝia ka aban ɓwangsǝki Ɓakuli. À tu-nggyal ama:
Agiryilǝmu mǝno ine ka, à ear ama, <<Amin, ɓǝ̀ do anggo!>> Sǝ aɓwana-mǝgule ka, à kpa a nzali aban peri.
